sources.quote: The plurals of a few nouns are formed from the singular by adding -n or -en, stemming from the Old English weak declension. Only the following three are commonly found:
sources.note: The three: ox/oxen, child/children, brother/brethren; the rest are listed as dialectal, rare or archaic.
